_comment: Broadcast-state evidence rules for TikTok LIVE Studio. UNVERIFIED SEED: these phrases were
written from typical Studio wording and have NOT been calibrated against real screenshots.
Set `verified` to true only after `studio-monitor calibrate-live <screenshot>` classifies real
LIVE and NOT_LIVE screenshots correctly. Until then the GUI labels the rules 'unverified'.
Classification per observation (one OCR pass over the live-status regions, or the whole
window when no live regions are configured):
- any `unknown.any` phrase present              -> UNKNOWN (loading / sign-in / reconnecting)
- live score >= live.min_score and not_live score < not_live.min_score  -> LIVE
- not_live score >= not_live.min_score and live score < live.min_score  -> NOT_LIVE
- anything else (no evidence, or contradictory evidence)              -> UNKNOWN
`requires_timer` (an HH:MM:SS / MM:SS elapsed timer must also be present), `score`.
A bare 'LIVE' word scores nothing on its own: it must come with a timer.

2026-10-09: on the real Studio UI the red 'Go LIVE' control is replaced by the elapsed timer while LIVE; there is no 'End LIVE' label. LIVE = timer in the control slot (score 1) + 'Upload: N kbps' with N>0 (score 1).
